info.name: DPLA API (Digital Public Library of America)
info.description:
Digital Public Library of America API v2: about 50M items from US libraries, archives, museums and state digital libraries.

**Setup:** run *0. Get an API key → Request a free API key* with your email, then paste the emailed key into the collection variable `dpla_api_key`. The collection auth then adds `api_key` to every request.

Docs: https://pro.dp.la/developers

request.description: One-time: **you** run this with your own email address. DPLA emails the 32-character key. Paste it into the collection variable **dpla_api_key**. An empty JSON reply or a message means the email was sent.
Searches about 50M items from US libraries, archives and museums. Requires api_key, which the collection auth adds.
Combine a surname with genealogy subject headings.
State names are spelled out in full.

query.description: case-sensitive: image | text | moving image | sound | physical object

request.description: Exact match on provider name, e.g. "Digital Library of Georgia".
Use the facet values to refine searches.
Results sorted by distance from lat,lon.
id comes from a search result (docs[].id).
